description: WhatsApp is rolling out a new trust warning feature for Android and iOS users. The feature is designed to provide additional information about unfamiliar contacts before a user opens a conversation. This feature helps users to make a more informed decision about whether to engage in a conversation. This warning message shows the country where the phone number is registered. It also verifies whether the number has been saved as a contact and whether the user shares any common groups with the sender.
title: WhatsApp Starts Warning Users About Chats From Unknown Numbers

description: Amazon on Tuesday announced the planned expansion of its quick commerce business in India. According to the e-commerce giant, the Amazon Now service will be expanded to more than 300 cities across the country in the coming years. Amazon claims its ultra-fast delivery service is the fastest-growing business unit in Amazon India’s history. Additionally, it announced a new delivery associate welfare programme, which focuses on education, insurance coverage, safety, and financial inclusion for workers across its logistics network.
title: Amazon Plans to Expand Quick Commerce Service to 300 Cities in India, Unveils Welfare Programme for Associates

description: Rockstar Games has finally announced confirmed the price and editions for Grand Theft Auto 6. The game will be available in Standard and Ultimate editions, priced at $79.99 and $99.99, respectively. GTA 6 pre-orders will go live at midnight local time on June 25.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Price, Editions Revealed; Pre-Orders Begin at Midnight on June 25

description: Financial infrastructure company OpenPayd has received authorisation under the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation, allowing it to operate as a crypto asset service provider across the European Economic Area through passporting. The licence, granted by Malta’s financial regulator, comes just days before the bloc’s MiCA transition deadline. The approval enables OpenPayd to expand services such as fiat on-ramp and off-ramp infrastructure for stablecoins across European markets.
title: OpenPayd Secures MiCA Licence as Stablecoins Gain Traction Across Europe

description: A Chinese tipster citing supply chain sources claims that the iPhone 18 Pro series will come with main camera upgrades. The leak suggests that the main camera module will be 2mm larger on the iPhone 18 Pro models compared to the previous models. They could come with triple rear camera units comprising three 48-megapixel sensors. The new phones could offer variable aperture.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Camera Upgrades Said to Result in Thicker Rear Camera Module, Larger Lenses

description: Sony expanded its home audio portfolio with the launch of the Bravia Theatre series on Tuesday. The latest lineup is headlined by the flagship Bravia Theatre trio wireless home theatre system. The company has also launched the Bravia Theatre Bar 7 and Theatre Bar 5 soundbars, along with Theatre Sub 9 and Sub 8 wireless subwoofers, and Theatre Rear 9 and Rear 8 wireless rear speakers. All of the models come with support for audio technologies such as Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, IMAX Enhanced, and 360 Spatial Sound Mapping.
title: Sony Bravia Theatre Trio Launched in India Alongside Bravia Theatre Bar 7, Bar 5 and New Wireless Speakers, Subwoofers

description: Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition launched in India with an aluminium frame. The new model has supercar-inspired design elements and runs on a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset. It has an IP64-rated protection against dust and water splashes. It has a dual rear camera unit including a 50-megapixel primary camera and a 6,500mAh battery that supports 90W wired fast charging and 30W wireless charging.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC

description: The Boat Airdopes ProClip launched in India with an open-ear ergonomic design. The earphones have an IPX4 rating for splash and sweat resistance and feature a 12mm dynamic driver. They offer Bluetooth 6.0 and support multi-point connectivity. The charging case of the earphones has a 500mAh battery, while each earbud features a 50mAh battery. The earphones are advertised to deliver up to 52 hours of total playback time at 60 percent volume.
title: Boat Airdopes ProClip Launched in India With 12mm Drivers, Up to 52 Hours Total Playback Time: Price, Features

description: THORChain has resumed full network operations after spending more than a month recovering from a $10.7 million exploit. The protocol said trading, swaps, signing, and liquidity provider functions have been restored following a series of security checks and upgrades. THORChain also completed keyshare verification for all nodes and used the KeyVerify protocol to validate most vaults, marking a major milestone in its recovery process after the May attack.
title: THORChain Resumes Operations Weeks After $10 Million Exploit

description: Sony Semiconductor Solutions announced the LYT-610 CMOS image sensor for smartphones on Tuesday. It is primarily aimed at telephoto cameras and can deliver improved image resolution and autofocus performance, leveraging a new RB2×2 On-Chip Lens (OCL) pixel structure. Sony says LYT-610 is the first mass-produced sensor in the industry to utilise this design. The image sensor supports 4K video recording at up to 120 frames per second (fps) and is expected to be used in future smartphone camera systems.
title: Sony Announces LYT-610 CMOS Image Sensor With 64-Megapixel Resolution, 4K 120fps Video Recording

description: Netflix has announced a new immersive horror video game coming to the streaming platform on June 30. Unhinged, developed by Oxenfree maker Night School Studio, stars Zoe Kravitz, Sadie Sink, and Troy Baker. The horror video game can be played on TV using your smartphone as a controller.
title: Netflix Announces Unhinged, an Immersive Horror Game Starring Zoë Kravitz That You Can Play on Your TV

description: Mozilla rolled out a new AI summarisation feature for Firefox on Android. The new feature known as Page Summaries can generate a brief overview of a webpage, helping users quickly understand its key points without having to read through the entire content. The new feature works on Firefox AI cloud-based solution powered by Mistral Small 3.1. Mozilla confirmed that the latest functionality is experimental and is being introduced to users through a progressive rollout. Enabling Shake to summarise is optional, and users can summarise pages using the toolbar button.
title: Firefox Now Lets You Shake Your Android Phone to Summarise Websites

description: Bitcoin remained under pressure on Wednesday as investors turned cautious amid a global selloff in technology stocks and uncertainty around US inflation data. Analysts said expectations of tighter monetary policy, weak institutional participation, and softer liquidity conditions continue to weigh on crypto markets, while traders closely monitor the $60,000 support level for signs of stability.
title: Bitcoin Slips Toward $62,000 Mark as US Tech Stock Selloff Dampens Risk Appetite

description: The Redmi K90 Ultra is all set to be launched in China next week, the company announced on Tuesday. The handset is expected to join the Xiaomi sub-brand's performance-focused K90 lineup, which already comprises the Redmi K90, K90 Pro, and K90 Max. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the company has begun teasing details about the upcoming handset. It is confirmed to be powered by Qualcomm’s flagship chipset from 2024. The design and thermal management capabilities of the Redmi K90 Ultra were also teased.
title: Redmi K90 Ultra China Launch Date Announced; Company Reveals Chipset Details Days Ahead of Debut

description: Meta intends to make a prediction markets app to rival the likes of Polymarket and Kalshi. The app will probably rely on a video game-like points system instead of users wagering money, though the company has not ruled out betting real money eventually, according to a New York Times report.
title: Mark Zuckerberg Directed Meta to Create a Prediction Markets App: Report

description: CI Games has delayed Lords of the Fallen 2 to 2027. The Soulslike action-RPG will now launch in Q1 of 2027. The studio said the delay would help develpers further refine and polish the game. Additionally, the delay will help Lords of the Fallen avoid a busy holiday period.
title: Lords of the Fallen 2 Delayed to 2027 to Allow for Further Polish, Avoid Busy Holiday Period

description: Nothing Phone 4b will launch on July 7. The new phone has now surfaced on Geekbench, confirming the use of Qualcomm’s  Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset. The upcoming phone is anticipated to retain Nothing's signature transparent design language. It will go on sale in India through Flipkart. It was spotted with the model number Nothing A009P. The listing shows a 1,088 single-core score and a 3,155 multi-core score.
title: Nothing Phone 4b Surfaces on Geekbench With Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 Chipset

description: The Vivo X500 series has been the talk of the rumour mill recently, with multiple leaks hinting at details about its display, battery, and camera hardware. A tipster has now shared details about the Vivo X500 Pro, which is expected to sit between the standard and the Pro Max models. The purported handset is said to be powered by an unannounced flagship processor from MediaTek. It will feature a compact display and a 50-megapixel primary camera.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Camera Specifications Tipped Again; Could Feature Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC, 85mm Periscope Lens

description: Samsung’s Galaxy Watch 9 renders have leaked online, showing the design. The renders show the wearable in two colour options. Samsung is expected to use Qualcomm's new Snapdragon Wear Elite chipset in the Galaxy Watch 9. It could come in 40mm and 44mm size options. It appears to feature a circular display housed within a squircle-shaped body. Sensors are placed underneath the watch.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 Appears Nearly Identical to Its Predecessor in Leaked Renders

description: Meta Platforms announced new AI-powered smart glasses in partnership with eyewear giant EssilorLuxottica. Simply dubbed Meta Glasses, they build upon the company’s existing Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta wearable lineup and bring refreshed designs. Meta has introduced three frame styles, including a special Kylie Jenner edition. The Meta Glasses are powered by the company’s Muse Spark AI model, which is said to enable more advanced multimodal interactions, live translation, hands-free photography, and contextual assistance.
title: Meta Glasses Launched With Muse Spark AI, 12-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: The Redmi Note 17 series is rumoured to be launched in China soon as the company’s latest mid-range lineup. While the brand has yet to confirm any details, a tipster has leaked key specifications of an upcoming model in the lineup. It is said to feature a significantly larger battery than its preceding models. The purported Redmi Note 17 series handset is tipped to offer a high-resolution display, improved durability, and a Snapdragon 6-series SoC under the hood.
title: Redmi Note 17 Series Phone Leaks With 9,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 6-Series Chip
